evident. The deposits are considered to be associated in general terms
with postglacial and interglacial/interstadial periods but reliable age
determinations are not available. In view of the mode of occurence of the
deposits conventional lithostratigraphic correlation is unlikely to be
applicable other than locally where original contiguity between deposits
can reasonably be expected or demonstrated. The use of lithostratigraphic
terminology for individual deposits is to be deprecated to avoid erecting a
multitude of localised and areally limited formations. Efforts should be
made to map the substantially transported deposits in terms of depositional

processes and morphology.
